source.title: Dataset for H2SAFE - Controlled Gas Releases and Sensor-Response for Indoor Hydrogen Safety

lab_1.vent_direction_declared: surface-normal or angle text, not a common 3-D vector

candidate.name: directional_vent_obstruction_rank_v3
formula_description: start with the fixed orientation-aware coordinate score
increase the score for a declared release jet aligned with the source-to-detector vector, decaying with distance
increase the score for same-frame ventilation aligned with the source-to-detector vector, capped at the reference speed
multiply by 0.6 for each declared axis-aligned obstruction intersecting the source-detector segment
required_same_frame_inputs: ventilation velocity vectors and origin/area metadata
obstruction geometry or an independently validated visibility map

evaluation.reason: H2SAFE Lab-2 publishes duct speeds and areas but not duct coordinates/vectors in the sensor frame; applying an invented vector would be post-hoc pseudo-validation.

decision.next_validation: Freeze this exact candidate before opening a rights-cleared cohort that publishes release vectors, HVAC vectors, obstruction geometry, signal units and release-time alignment in one coordinate frame.

claim_boundary: This record demonstrates a reproducible, transparent development candidate and an input-readiness gap. It does not validate hydrogen concentration, detector placement, alarm or ESD setpoints, CFD, consequence distance, outdoor dispersion or the full HRS digital twin.
